name: dsh-git-plugin
description: dsh Git 插件 monorepo v0.1.0（@dsh-plugin/git host + @dsh-plugin/client-ui-git client + @dsh-plugin/git-bundle 发布薄包），接口权威见 docs/capability-spec.md

scripts.typecheck: pnpm run build:host && tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/host/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/client-ui/tsconfig.json
scripts.build:host: cd packages/host && pnpm exec tsdown && pnpm exec tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
